description: From the harbor, the Castillo de San Gabriel stands on its islet at the end of the Puente de las Bolas — the little fortress floodlit against the night, its cannonballs-on-pillars bridge arching across the dark water. The harbor lights of Arrecife glow behind it while the causeway's lamps trace a line to the castle. Lanzarote's old pirate-proof fortress keeps its watch over the capital's bay.
